header.title: Muse AI and software-agent ontology
header.description: Framework-neutral software-agent, model, message, context, tool, delegation, and representational-state concepts.

definition.text: A temporally bounded event/interaction episode in which a software agent performs work under a run identity.
An agent whose capacity for action is realized through an engineered artificial system.
A representational state recording content treated by the software agent as currently accepted or relied upon, without asserting phenomenological equivalence to human belief.
An information artifact representing one explicitly offered candidate answer or action for a question prompt; its presence does not assert that the candidate is true or selected.
An information artifact representing information supplied or retained as context for an agent or model invocation.
A bounded context artifact supplied to a specific model invocation, including its ordered model-visible content.
A communicative event contributing one participant's message/content to a conversation sequence.
An action by which an agent or harness assigns a task/subtask to another agent or execution scope.
An information artifact generated by a model-backed agent or model invocation.
A representational state in which propositional content is treated as a hypothesis/candidate rather than as an unqualified assertion.
A model artifact whose inference interface maps linguistic or tokenized context to distributions or generated linguistic/token content.
An information artifact containing communicative content with source-specified sender/addressee semantics; existence of the artifact does not by itself establish successful delivery.
A communicative act in which a message artifact is delivered or otherwise communicated to an addressee; a requested send operation does not establish that this act occurred.
A software artifact encoding learned parameters and associated model structure/configuration used for inference.
A software agent whose behavior generation materially depends on invocation of one or more learned model artifacts.
An event in which a model artifact is invoked with an input/context to produce model output or an error.
An information artifact supplied to an agent as an observation of tool, environment, user, or system state.
An information artifact specifying interrogative content to be presented to an addressee, including structured choice prompts used by agent tools.
A computational state that explicitly represents propositional or task-relevant content for a software agent; it is not thereby identified with a human mental moment.
An artificial agent whose operational realization is software executing in a computing environment.
A task whose intended execution is subordinate to another task.
A plan/goal description specifying work requested or adopted for an agent run.
A source-attributed situation describing the lifecycle/status state of an agent task without implying that the task's planned work has been completed.
A software artifact exposed to an agent through a callable operation interface.
An event in which an agent/harness requests execution of a tool operation with structured arguments.
A source-visible information artifact reporting lifecycle state or revised metadata for an already identified tool invocation; observing this artifact does not constitute another invocation event.
An information artifact returned or recorded as the result/error payload of a tool invocation.
An information artifact specifying a tool's callable identity, arguments, result/error contract, and relevant semantics.

agent:choiceOptionDescription.definition: Relates a choice option to its exact source-visible descriptive text.

agent:choiceOptionExpressesContent.definition: Relates a choice option to semantic content expressed by that option; the relation does not assert or select that content.

agent:choiceOptionLabel.definition: Relates a choice option to its exact source-visible short label.

agent:delegatedTo.definition: Relates a delegation action to the receiving software agent.

agent:delegatesTask.definition: Relates a delegation action to the task/subtask delegated.

agent:deliversMessage.definition: Relates a message-delivery communicative act to the message artifact delivered or communicated by that act.

agent:generatedByInvocation.definition: Relates generated content to the model invocation that generated it.

agent:hasTask.definition: Relates an agent run to a task it is attempting or performing.

agent:invokesModel.definition: Relates a model invocation event to the model artifact invoked.

agent:invokesTool.definition: Relates a tool invocation event to the tool being invoked.

agent:messageCarriesArtifact.definition: Relates a message to an information artifact included or referenced as communicated content.

agent:messageExpressesProposition.definition: Relates a message to propositional content it expresses; this does not establish that the message was successfully delivered.

agent:messageReceiver.definition: Relates a message to an identified receiver/addressee.

agent:messageSender.definition: Relates a message to the agent or other participant identified as its sender.

agent:messageSummary.definition: Relates a message to an explicitly supplied short summary string without treating the summary as a separate asserted message.

agent:modelInvocationUsesContext.definition: Relates a model invocation to context supplied to that invocation.

agent:observationForAgent.definition: Relates an observation artifact to the software agent to which it was supplied.

agent:observationForRun.definition: Relates an observation artifact to the agent run in which it was supplied.

agent:questionPromptExpressesContent.definition: Relates a structured question prompt to interrogative semantic content without asserting any embedded proposition as true.

agent:questionPromptHasOption.definition: Relates a structured question prompt to one explicitly offered choice option.

agent:questionPromptHeader.definition: Relates a structured question prompt to its explicitly supplied short header/title string.

agent:questionPromptMultiSelect.definition: Relates a structured question prompt to its source-specified multi-select flag.

agent:representsProposition.definition: Relates an agent representational state to propositional content it computationally represents.

agent:runOf.definition: Relates an agent run to the software agent performing work in that run.

agent:runUsesContext.definition: Relates an agent run to context retained or supplied within that run.

agent:subtaskOf.definition: Relates a subtask to the task under which it is scoped.

agent:taskStateOf.definition: Relates a source-attributed task-state situation to the task whose lifecycle/status it describes.

agent:taskStateValue.definition: Relates a task-state situation to its exact source-reported status token represented as a string value.

agent:toolInvocationDurationMillis.definition: Relates a tool invocation to a source-reported elapsed duration in milliseconds represented as an integer data value.

agent:toolInvocationHasArgument.definition: Relates a tool invocation to an explicitly supplied argument artifact.

agent:toolInvocationInRun.definition: Relates a tool invocation to the agent run within which it occurred.

agent:toolInvocationObservedEffect.definition: Relates a tool invocation to an effect event independently established by structured source evidence; result success alone is insufficient evidence for this relation.

agent:toolInvocationParent.definition: Relates a nested tool invocation to the enclosing/parent tool invocation explicitly identified by the source.

agent:toolInvocationPrincipal.definition: Relates a tool invocation to the agent or harness object that initiated the invocation according to the structured source record.

agent:toolInvocationRequestedEffect.definition: Relates a tool invocation to propositional effect content requested by the invocation. The proposition is intensional content and is not independently asserted as an observed world change.

agent:toolInvocationResult.definition: Relates a tool invocation to its returned/recorded result artifact without asserting independent external effects.

agent:toolInvocationRetryOf.definition: Relates a tool invocation to a prior tool invocation that the source explicitly identifies as the attempt being retried.

agent:toolInvocationUpdateCarriesResult.definition: Relates a lifecycle/update artifact to a tool-result artifact explicitly carried in that update; this does not independently verify external effects described by the result.

agent:toolInvocationUpdateFor.definition: Relates a lifecycle/update artifact to the tool invocation whose state or metadata it reports; this relation may be added only when exact source identity establishes the join.

agent:toolInvocationUpdateStatus.definition: Relates a lifecycle/update artifact to its exact source-reported status token represented as a string value.

agent:toolResultDiagnostic.definition: Relates a tool-result artifact to a diagnostic information artifact explicitly returned or recorded with it.

agent:toolResultOfInvocation.definition: Relates a tool-result artifact to the exact tool invocation whose returned/result record it is, only when source identity establishes the join.

agent:toolResultOutcome.definition: Relates a tool-result artifact to the execution outcome that the structured result explicitly reports for the tool operation. A failure outcome classifies the operation/result status; it does not negate or invalidate other payload observations that completed before the failure.

agent:toolResultPayload.definition: Relates a tool-result artifact to its exact source-visible payload represented as a literal; this records returned content and does not independently establish external effects.

agent:toolSpecifiedBy.definition: Relates a tool to its callable specification.

agent:turnCarriesMessage.definition: Relates a conversational turn to the message/content artifact contributed by that turn.

agent:usesModel.definition: Relates a model-backed agent to a model artifact it invokes as part of its operation.
